name: Punctured-Triangle Corner-Cap Contraction Obstructions
definition: Let $X=\{a,b,c,x\}\mathbin{\dot\cup}Z$ with $Z\ne\varnothing$, and let $\mathcal L_\triangle=\{\{a\},\{b\},\{a,b\},\{a,c\},\{b,c\},\{a,b,c\}\}$. Delete $\mathcal L_\triangle$, the corner $\{a,x\}$, and the cap $\{\{a,c,x\}\cup S:S\subseteq Z\}$ from $2^X$. Attach a new pendant coordinate $f$ at the empty endpoint of the resulting base.
parameters: $d=|X|\ge5$ and $Z\ne\varnothing$. The pendant family has $2^d-2^{|Z|}-6$ states.
canonical_form: The local punctured triangle is decorated by the missing corner $\{a,x\}$ and the cap anchored at $\{a,c,x\}$ over the nonempty support $Z$.
recognition: A construction certificate verifies the valid base root $\{a,b,c,x\}$, the exact holes at $\varnothing$ and $X$, and repair sets $\{a,b,c,x\}$ and $Z$.
comments: Every member is contraction-minimal outside learning-space graphs. No pc-minimality or completeness claim is made because learning-space graphs are not closed under convex restrictions.
